purpose: Enumerate every UNSEALED data surface that has already been used or seen, so the Part-2 CONFIRMATION split can be PROVEN disjoint (untouched) at mint time; and mark the sealed promotion holdout as never-touch. This is a review artifact; it approves nothing and mints nothing.

used_surfaces.surface: Arm-1 dev-selection (7 languages x 60 = 420 held-out DEV rows)
used_surfaces.exposure: USED for Arm-1 checkpoint / development selection
used_surfaces.eligibility: SCREENING ONLY — already seen; NOT valid as an independent confirmation set (Codex round 31 finding 3)

used_surfaces.surface: frozen dev sentinels — lingala (60 rows), swahili (60 rows)
used_surfaces.exposure: USED as the Arm-2 calibration dev sentinels (directional dev-WER)
USED for training (Arm-1 and the Arm-2 calibration)

sealed_never_touch.rule: NEVER opened by this protocol. Promotion/qualification only. Part-2 is unsealed and directional; it must not read or derive from the sealed holdout.

confirmation_split_requirements.source: the UNSELECTED remainder of each tier-2 dev pool (rows never drawn into the 420 selection surface, the screening sentinels, or Arm-1 training), NEVER the sealed holdout
confirmation_split_requirements.disjointness_proof_required: at mint, every confirmation row's audio_checksum_sha256 MUST be disjoint from EVERY used_surface above AND from the sealed_never_touch holdout; the proof is committed alongside the frozen manifest
freeze_requirements: per-pool S3 version_id + etag + KMS pins
committed to git BEFORE any finalist run
opened ONCE for finalist + KD_CONTROL confirmation

holds: Nothing here authorizes minting, selection, sealed evaluation, promotion, or deployment. All remain held.
